newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gov't says wheat not hit by frost.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gov't says wheat not hit by frost.

text.p: Recent frosts in Argentina's southern wheat belt caused little damage, the Agriculture Secretariat said Thursday in its weekly crop report, dated October 25.
"Fortunately, in general the wheat was not very affected by these low temperatures," the Secretariat said.

Temperatures fell as low as 4.5 degrees Celsius below zero at a five-centimeter soil depth in parts of Buenos Aires and La Pampa provinces in the night of October 19 and the following early morning, the Secretariat said.
But there was some damage in the areas of Villarino and Patagones, where wheat plants were at a more developed and so more susceptible stage. The extent of damage will not be known for 10 days.
The Secretariat Thursday maintained its estimation of the season's wheat output at 14.9 million tonnes, up from 9.2 million tonnes in 1995/96.
